title: libgit2 bundled PCRE heap buffer overflow
summary: The bundled PCRE regular-expression engine can write one byte past a heap buffer for a crafted revspec.
ai_role: Anthropic CVD item explicitly attributes discovery to Claude Mythos Preview; the libgit2 advisory identifies the matching issue.
classification_note: Public disclosure is documented. Sources do not establish exploitation in the wild or zero-day status. CVD finding is static-analysis-only; no CVE confirmed.
remediation_note: The advisory lists no patched libgit2 version. It describes a structural fix in PCRE2 that was not backported to bundled PCRE 8.x.

impacts.conditions: With libgit2’s default built-in PCRE backend, a specially structured `:/pattern` revspec can cause a deterministic one-byte heap out-of-bounds write in PCRE. Any consumer passing attacker-influenced strings to revspec is exposed; no downstream consequence is established.
impacts.exploitation: The advisory confirms a deterministic reachable trigger; it does not establish exploitation in the wild.
